experiment_data.hypothesis: SciERC hidden state probe: test if linear classifier on last-layer hidden states can predict entity quality (match vs non-match against gold). If AUROC ≈ 0.98 (consistent with FewNERD=0.987, CoNLL=0.980), confirms entity quality info is universally encoded in representations across datasets, and prompt-based self-judgment (ESJ AUROC=0.51) fails to access this information.
